subject: english
options: Our is an adjective that follows classroom.
The can only appear at sentence end.
The and our compete for the same determiner position.

optionRationales.reason: Classroom must always be plural.：名詞數不是問題。
Our is an adjective that follows classroom.：our 應放名詞前且屬限定詞。
The can only appear at sentence end.：the 一般置於名詞片語前。
The and our compete for the same determiner position.：冠詞與所有格不能如此並列。

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「依限定詞互斥、數量、形容詞位置與後置限定順序，組成語意清楚且一致的完整名詞片語。」可推出 The and our compete for the same determiner position.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 The and our compete for the same determiner position. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
